summary:
Full backend + frontend E2E testing of the 8-change batch (iteration 22). Backend: 4/4 pytest cases pass (normalize-sources returns {normalized:}; PUT/GET /budget/income-sources roundtrip persists custom_name for Personal/APX/USA; confirm-match endpoint wired [admin has no open candidates so 400/404 path exercised]; mark-cash on a consumo sets source='factura_sri' + is_deductible=true as verified by subsequent GET). Frontend (1366x1024 iPad landscape, logged in as admin earauzt@gmail.com): all 5 acceptance criteria pass — (1) 74 tx rows with bulk-checkbox-; (2) bulk-toolbar appears above list when ≥1 selected; bulk-category-select + bulk-subcategory-select + bulk-apply-btn present, button text dynamically shows 'Aplicar a N transacciones' for N=1 and N=2; (3) no rows show 'FacturaFactura' or 'Ha recibido...' prefixes (description fallback effective); (4) edit tx modal has overflow-y-auto max-h-[90vh] on DialogContent + DialogFooter.sticky.bottom-0.bg-white.pt-3.border-t; Actualizar button sits at y=911 inside 1024 viewport; (5) Ingresos 'Nueva ingreso' dialog shows distribution-btn-Personal/APX/USA + source-name-edit-* pencils; click pencil opens source-name-input-, typing + Enter updates label (Personal btn re-renders as custom name) and PUTs /budget/income-sources; Perfil 'Comercios (23)' tab → vendor-edit- opens modal with vendor-edit-category-select (combobox, 12 options: Servicios Básicos/Suscripciones/Empleados/Colegio/Seguros/Comida/...) and vendor-edit-subcategory-select (combobox). No regressions observed in sidebar, navigation, or Spanish UI. Pre-existing benign console warnings only: hydration warning in Perfil (

contains

) — not introduced in this batch.

design_issues.screen: Transactions rows with only a date + 'otros'
issues: Some rows show only the date (e.g., '17 abr 2026') with no title because fallback comercio/descripcion_corta are null and the regex strips the entire description to empty. Consider adding a final fallback to establishment or 'Sin descripción' when the 40-char trimmed output is empty.

passed_tests: PUT /api/budget/income-sources → 200, GET /api/budget/personal?year=2026 returns income_sources.{Personal,APX,USA}.custom_name exactly as written
POST /api/sri/confirm-match wired (400/404 path confirms endpoint mounted)
POST /api/sri/mark-cash/{consumo_id} → 200 {status:'con_respaldo', created_cash_tx:false}; subsequent GET shows tx.source='factura_sri' and tx.is_deductible=true
Bulk toolbar [data-testid='bulk-toolbar'] appears only when ≥1 selected; disappears on Cancelar
bulk-apply-btn text updates: 'Aplicar a 1 transacciones' → 'Aplicar a 2 transacciones'
No rows start with 'FacturaFactura' / 'Factura' / 'Ha recibido su documento electrónico' (0/74)
Edit tx DialogContent classes include overflow-y-auto and max-h-[90vh]
Edit tx DialogFooter is sticky bottom-0 bg-white pt-3 border-t; Actualizar button rendered within 1024px viewport
Ingresos 'Nueva ingreso' dialog: distribution-btn-Personal/APX/USA + source-name-edit-Personal/APX/USA present
source-name-edit-Personal click → source-name-input-Personal input; type 'MiPersonal' + Enter updates distribution-btn-Personal label
Perfil /tab-comercios: 23 vendor rows; vendor-edit-<id> opens modal
vendor-edit-category-select (role=combobox) opens dropdown with 12 PERSONAL_CATEGORIES options
action_items: (Low priority polish) In Transactions.js row description fallback, add a final guard: if the regex-trimmed description is empty, fall back to establishment or 'Sin descripción' to avoid rows that show only the date.

critical_code_review_comments: sri_match.confirm-match: the $regex source match 'factura|gmail' correctly covers legacy sources (gmail_pdf, gmail_factura_pdf, factura_sri, etc.) — idempotency looks solid.
budget.save_income_sources uses upsert, correct. GET /budget/personal only returns income_sources if personal_budgets doc exists; value is null for fresh users — that is acceptable.

documents._upsert_card_from_statement: the substring match can over-match if one card name is a substring of another (e.g., 'Visa' contained in 'Visa Diners'). Current data is safe but worth a comment if this becomes an issue.
Transactions.js bulk handler: handleBulkApply fires sequential PUTs (await per id) — acceptable for small N, but if bulk of 50+ is common, consider Promise.all with a small concurrency cap.

Ingresos.js saveSourceName: label is read from a React state local copy but persisted via a separate API call; make sure a failed PUT reverts the local state (toast on error is shown; state is not reverted).
seed_data_creation: TEST_iter22_consumo expense created during mark-cash test and deleted in teardown. Income-sources custom_name set to 'TEST_<role>_<uuid6>' via roundtrip test; overwritten on next real save. No persistent test pollution.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
All 8 items in the iteration 22 batch are verified end-to-end. Backend pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration22_batch.py can be re-run at any time and covers normalize-sources, income-sources roundtrip, confirm-match wiring, and mark-cash consumo branch. Frontend: the bulk categorization toolbar, vendor edit dropdowns, and Ingresos source-name edit are all functional. The only non-blocking polish is the empty-description rows on Transactions when both comercio and descripcion_corta are null and the description starts with 'Factura...' — the regex strips everything.
